jonny-desktop.task: meristem/vanguard: bake all 8 direction rows into battle sheets using humanoid_facings, so 87 percent of every sheet stops being blank and non-south facings render
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED. meristem @ df2d788 on main; vanguard @ c882d96 on regions/side-areas. Cloned the LPC generator and read it as a HUMAN REFERENCE rather than shipping its art, which sidesteps the CC-BY-SA licensing concern entirely. LPC standard measured from the actual sheets, not recalled: 64x64 cells, 4 direction rows, walk 9 frames, slash 6, thrust 8, spellcast 7, shoot 13, hurt 6, run 8, jump 5, idle 2. FOUND AND FIXED THE BIGGEST STRUCTURAL GAP: every Vanguard battle sheet is 24x8 cells and ONLY ROW 0 was ever written, so 87 percent of every sheet was blank - and BattleSpriteLoader.create_battle_frames takes a direction argument, meaning any request for a non-south facing rendered NOTHING. Meristem was already drawing four cardinals via humanoid_facings and had been feeding them to the overworld sheets all along; the battle sheet simply never asked. ROW_FACING now maps Vanguard's eight compass rows (S SW W NW N NE E SE) onto those four with each diagonal taking its nearest cardinal, and non-humanoids repeat their single drawn view across all rows rather than leaving seven blank - a wolf that renders when asked for west beats a wolf that vanishes. VERIFIED the rows are real art and not eight copies of south: W and E are side profiles, N/NW/NE show the back of the head, S/SW/SE the face. 92 sheets rebaked, 1100 resources load. REMAINING GAP vs LPC, recorded in DECISIONS.md: frame COUNTS are still thin - Vanguard walk 6 vs LPC 9, sword 4 vs slash 6 / thrust 8, hurt 1 vs 6. Closing those means either more archetype frame functions in Meristem or richer pose recipes per band. Also still open from the reference sheets: 19 of 43 creatures are archetype 'humanoid' including granite_golem, lattice_sentinel and crystallized_stillkeeper, which need non-humanoid archetypes rather than a recolour.
